title: DVito supplier model needs crew-scoped access and separate payer-recipient order records
summary: The requested supplier model requires an owner funding promos from a personal DITO account while crew use their own dashboards. Existing Project DVito listAccounts selects all accounts without crew membership filtering; groups are organizational labels, not access boundaries. Its promo buy handler uses the selected account's token, mobile and customer identifier together, so it does not implement a separate supplier payer and crew recipient. The schema has no supplier-order or crew-payment ledger. Recipient-validation leads exist in the research catalog, but supplier-wallet-funded promo delivery remains unverified. Existing account monitoring can inform the new design; access scoping and order accounting require explicit additions.

evidence.description: listAccounts and buy handlers use a shared account pool and selected-account payment identity.
buyPromo implements the selected-account load-funded purchase request.
Current schema lacks crew membership and supplier transaction records.
Recipient-validation leads do not prove supplier-wallet payment acceptance.

nextSteps: Draft the owner and crew workflow with proposed decisions clearly separated from confirmed requirements.
Establish payer, recipient, eligibility, supported payment methods and delivery confirmation before enabling supplier purchase execution.
